title: Use and Design of Peer Evaluations for Bonus Allocations

scopes.description: All supplied steps in Code.do: prepare variables from RawData.dta, reproduce the supplied manuscript analyses (lines 247–1,020) and all included online-appendix Sections A and B (lines 1,025–1,438), with portable input loading and grstyle setup. This target does not add paper-wide analyses or historical experiment collection that are not supplied as runnable code. The code does not specify persisted table or figure filenames.

requirements.description: The complete supplied Stata workflow starts from the packaged experiment-level RawData.dta dataset. Code.do recodes treatment assignment, creates employee/team variables from the nine-period experiment panel, and runs the supplied manuscript and online-appendix analyses. The existing readable probe confirms all 54 code-consumed input columns. The one-row probe does not establish full-sample coverage, which remains a later validation limit for this exact author input.

routes.description: The registered one-row DTA probe is readable at the exact packaged location and lists all 54 fields used by the active code. It reports coverage_verified=false; this is retained as a bounded-probe limit rather than a requirement for an additional full-data sweep. Code.do and the actual file use peqprocedfairness1–4 and peqdistrifairness1–4; the dictionary spells those two families differently, but the packaged data matches the code.
routes.expected_period: Experiment periods 1–9; the dictionary describes periods 1–8 as rounds and period 9 as after round 8.

software.name: Stata
software.description: The original registered successful environment probe reports Stata available, version 18. The author release is unspecified, so retain release-specific output validation as a later check; no concrete syntax incompatibility is supported.

software.name: grstyle
software.description: The supplied graph sections invoke grstyle. The exact metadata probe in Stata 18 returned available=false and which_returncode=111; add-on setup is needed before the supplied figures can be attempted.

issues.description: Code.do has a RawData.dta load heading and platform-specific load examples inside a block comment; the active script begins with variable renames and therefore expects RawData.dta already loaded in memory.

	label var designtreatment "designTreatment"

evidence.description: The raw treatment fields are renamed before the analysis variables are built.
The driver constructs employee averages over selected round starts and a team contribution measure before using period 9 outputs.

evidence.quote:
** GENERATING PROCESS FACTOR VARIABLES FOR FAIRNESS PERCEPTIONS
** Procedural Fairness Factor - Employee Level
factor peqprocedfairness1 peqprocedfairness2 peqprocedfairness3 peqprocedfairness4 if subjectnr<4
	rotate
	predict peqprocedfairness_factor
** Distributive Fairness Factor	- Employee Level
factor peqdistrifairness1 peqdistrifairness2 peqdistrifairness3 peqdistrifairness4 if subjectnr<4
	rotate
	predict peqdistrifairness_factor
evidence.description: The preparation code consumes the two abbreviated fairness item families and creates factors later used in analysis.

evidence.description: The plotting branch calls the grstyle add-on as well as Stata graph commands.

evidence.quote:
********************************************************************************
** ONLINE APPENDIX, SECTION A
********************************************************************************

factor peqprocedfairness1 peqprocedfairness2 peqprocedfairness3 peqprocedfairness4 if subjectnr<4
rotate

********************************************************************************
** TABLE A.2
********************************************************************************
// Column 1: Effort
reg contribution_1_8 design use int_design_use if subjectnr<4 & period==9, vce(cluster groupnr)
// Column 2: Distributive Fairness
reg peqdistrifairness_factor design use int_design_use if subjectnr<4 & period==9, vce(cluster groupnr)
// Column 3: Effort
reg contribution_1_8 design use int_design_use peqdistrifairness_factor if subjectnr<4 & period==9, vce(cluster groupnr)
evidence.description: Section A repeats a fairness-factor step and supplies Table A.2 analyses.

evidence.quote:
********************************************************************************
** ONLINE APPENDIX, SECTION B
********************************************************************************

********************************************************************************
** TABLE B.1: FINAL BONUS
********************************************************************************
** PANEL A: DECISION LEVEL
// Column 1: Formulaic Use & Self-Including Design
reg finalbonus contribution if subjectnr<4 & period<9 & use==0 & design==0, vce(cluster groupnr)
// Column 2: Formulaic Use & Self-Including Design
reg finalbonus contribution if subjectnr<4 & period<9 & use==0 & design==1, vce(cluster groupnr)
// Column 3: Discretionary Use & Self-Including Design
reg finalbonus contribution if subjectnr<4 & period<9 & use==1 & design==0, vce(cluster groupnr)
// Column 4: Discretionary Use & Self-Excluding Design
reg finalbonus contribution if subjectnr<4 & period<9 & use==1 & design==1, vce(cluster groupnr)
// Column 5: All Conditions
reg finalbonus contribution int_contribution_design int_contribution_use int_contribution_design_use design use int_design_use if subjectnr<4 & period<9, vce(cluster groupnr)
evidence.description: Section B includes the separate final-bonus branch and a full-model interaction analysis.

evidence.quote:
playernr                          Number assigned to a given participant (i.e., a player number is

evidence.quote:
allotreatment                     Treatment dummy variable capturing the use of peer
                                     evaluations (0: allocation by manager, 1: allocation by team)
allotreatmentname                 Corresponding name of treatment variable for use (0: Manager
                                     Allocation, 1: Team Allocation)
proptreatment                     Treatment dummy variable capturing design of peer
                                     evaluations (0: self-including, 1: self-excluding)
proptreatmentname                 Corresponding name of treatment variable for design (0: Self-
                                     Including, 1: Self-Excluding)
contribution                      A given employee participant’s contribution in a given round,
                                     ranging from 0 to 40 (in multiples of two)
teamoutput                        Team output generated by a given participant’s team
proposala                         A given employee participant’s proposed bonus for employee A
                                     in a given round.
proposalb                         A given employee participant’s proposed bonus for employee B
                                     in a given round.
proposalc                         A given employee participant’s proposed bonus for employee C
                                     in a given round.
finalbonusa                       Bonus allocated to employee A in a given round.
finalbonusb                       Bonus allocated to employee B in a given round.
finalbonusc                       Bonus allocated to employee C in a given round.
earningsround                     A given participant’s earnings in a given round.

review_notes: Final source review: Code.do was screened byte-first and all 1,438 physical lines were read through the redacted viewer; it is the sole supplied entry driver for variable construction, manuscript results, and online appendix Sections A and B.

The work-item dependency checklist and static architecture dependency edge list are empty. The source review independently accounts for its sole required empirical input, RawData.dta. No additional commercial/public resource lookup was indicated by the actual supplied code; Sona and LIONESS are historical experiment context, not live file inputs in Code.do.

The registered RawData.dta probe is a successful one-row metadata read with all 54 code-consumed fields. Its coverage_verified=false and one-row sampling limits are retained; no whole-data sweep or execution trial was performed. The dictionary spells two fairness families differently, but the actual packaged columns match the active code, so no field-mapping issue remains for this route.

The original environment probe supports Stata availability and version 18. Exact grstyle metadata reports unavailable, so the only software setup action is grstyle. The author Stata release is unspecified; this is a future compatibility/output check, not a confirmed incompatibility.

The datasheet and online appendix title lines agree with the frozen title. The datasheet physical lines 26–174 and appendix lines 1329–1330 were withheld before decoding by the byte-first candidate screen; candidate text was not displayed and no scientific claim relies on those withheld regions.

Process retention: the screen-reader fictional self-test had failed assertion attempts before the final pass; each pre-repair source version and combined tool output summary is retained in probes. Two shell redirection path slips occurred before reader launch; their empty stdout originals and exact in-scope copies are retained, with the capture limits documented in the incident JSON records. These process artifacts are unused as scientific evidence.

Helper-order limit: the environment viewer and grstyle frozen-helper source copies were saved in probes after their calls, not before. The exact frozen sources already existed under the assigned generation and their hashes were verified; copies and commands/results are retained, no alternate helper was executed, and no claims of pre-execution copies are made.
